newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Keppel Philippine units post mixed results.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Philippine units post mixed results.

text.p: The results of the three Philippine subsidiaries of Keppel Group of Singapore varied last year, local flagship Keppel Philippines Holdings Inc said on Friday.
Keppel Philippines Holdings itself posted a slight dip in net income to 111.108 million pesos last year as against 113.184 million pesos in 1995, despite a 10 percent increase in revenues.
The company attributed the marginal decline to higher tax payment and payment to minority interests.

"Group operating profit at 130 million pesos was 12 percent higher than that in 1995," the company said in a statement. The group's non-operating income rose 88 percent to 45 million due mainly to the gain from the sale of the floating dock at subsidiary Kepphil Shipyard, it added.
Kepphil Shipyard Inc reported a net income of 94.305 million pesos from 93.659 million pesos in 1995.
Kepphil said higher ship repair activities boosted its bottom line last year.
It said the construction of a 40,000 dead weight tonne drydock, which started last year, was expected to be completed by the first half of 1998.
Another subsidiary, Cebu Shipyard & Engineering Works Inc, said it posted a net income of 63.471 million pesos in 1996 from 58.091 million pesos in 1995.
"The yard enjoyed high occupancy rates in 1996, with the number of vessels repaired totalling 181 compared to 156 in 1995," Cebu Shipyard said in its statement.
It said it had also modified its existing slipway to cater to the repairs of high speed aluminium catamaran vessels, the fast growing market segment in the industry.
